# k.compiler: Compiler and artifacts
status: conformance-covered

**API.** One Vite plugin on oxc, no options. Project shape comes from module manifests, `routes.ts`, `tokens.ts`, and `topology.ts`.
```ts
// vite.config.ts (generated by scaffold)
import keel from '@keel/compiler/vite'
export default { plugins: [keel()] }
```

**Output.** JSX compiles to direct DOM operations (k.runtime); there is no virtual DOM and no diffing. A component function runs once per instance. Each dynamic expression becomes one binding (text, attribute, property, or event) that updates only its own node. Static subtrees are hoisted into templates built once and cloned. `If`, `For`, `Match`/`Case`, and `Boundary` are compiler intrinsics imported from `@keel/runtime-dom`; they lower to runtime ops, not component calls. `For` requires `key` naming a field of the item schema; when order changes, rows move rather than re-create.

**Escaping by context.** Text children always become text nodes. Attributes and properties are set through the DOM, never string-concatenated. Server HTML escapes text and attribute contexts separately. **URL policy** (the one statement; runtime ops and `@keel/ui` `Link`/`Image` apply it, RFC 0024): URL attributes are `href`, `src`, `action`, `formaction`, `xlink:href`, `poster`, and `ping` (each space-separated URL). Navigation attributes (`href`, `action`, `formaction`, `Link to`) take an `Href` from `routes.href()` or an absolute URL; a literal path there that starts with `/` or matches a `routes.json` path pattern is E1501 (k.router). `src`, `poster`, `ping`, and `xlink:href` are assets: relative literals (`logo.png`) are allowed. A value whose scheme, after the whitespace and control characters the URL parser skips, is not `http`, `https`, `mailto`, or `tel` renders as `about:blank`; no scheme is relative. `srcdoc` is raw HTML: every value renders as `about:blank`. Raw HTML has no API outside `unsafe`.

**Artifacts.** Written to `.keel/` on every build and dev change. JSON, sorted keys, byte-identical for identical sources. Each file carries a content hash; all are read-only.
- `deps.json`: reactive graph, nodes and edges (k.reactive).
- `ids.json`: `{ [elementId]: { file, line, col, component, tag, role } }`, one entry per element (k.component ids).
- `routes.json`: `{ [routeId]: { path, params, search, actions, layout, guard, module } }`; schemas as JSON Schema.
- `a11y.json`: per element id, expected `role` and the source of its accessible name (`label`, `alt`, `text`, `aria`); read by `check` and the harness. Its rules are one table, `@keel/compiler/a11y`, that the harness applies to the DOM (WAI-ARIA 1.2, HTML-AAM): `img` with literal `alt=""` is `presentation`, unnamed; `section` without `aria-label(ledby)` is `generic`; name from content only for non-control roles whose ARIA 1.2 "Name From" includes contents (so not `listitem`). A role, input `type`, or `select` `size`/`multiple` unknown statically is `null`, not compared.

**Build-time evaluation.** `tokens.ts` and each `routes.ts` run once in Node. A thrown error with an E code keeps it; else `tokens.ts` throwing or exporting no tokens is E1807 (k.ui), a `routes.ts` throwing or exporting no `routes` is E1006, each with file and message. Any other failure is E1049.

**Rules.** E1000 source does not parse (at the parser's location, `syntax error: <parser message>` under 90 chars; the file gets no other rule, element, or lowering; also at build-time evaluation) · E1001 `For` without `key`, or `key` not a field of the item · E1002 `innerHTML`, `outerHTML`, `insertAdjacentHTML`, or `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` in app code · E1003 any `srcdoc`, or a literal the URL policy renders as `about:blank` in a URL attribute or `Link to`/`Image src`; fix removes the attribute, except a required prop · E1004 a `*.server.ts` module imported from client-reachable code (ADR-0006; evaluated per deployable: a file under `modules/<m>/` belongs to every deployable listing `m`; not reported when all of them declare no server, since a client-only build bundles loaders and actions to the browser, nor for the `routes.ts` of a module only `node` deployables list, which the server loads; files outside `modules/` such as tests, configs, and the server entry are never subject) · E1005 hand edit to generated output (`.keel/`, `turbo.json`, CI workflows, Dockerfiles, generated API schemas); fix: revert and regenerate · E1006 `routes.ts` fails to evaluate · E1049 internal compiler failure: the message verbatim, no app location, never an app code; fix: report it.

**Conformance.**
- Compiling the same sources twice yields byte-identical JS and artifacts.
- Updating one signal changes only the DOM nodes bound to it; every other node keeps its identity.
- A string containing `<script>` or `"><img onerror=x>` rendered as a child or attribute value appears verbatim as text or attribute value and creates no element.
- A dynamic `href` whose value is `javascript:alert(1)` renders as `about:blank`.
- `ids.json` has exactly one entry per element in source, and each key is an id the harness `find(id)` resolves.
- Reordering a keyed `For` list preserves the DOM node identity of every row.
- Changing any byte of a file under `.keel/` makes `keel check` report E1005 on that file.
- A component with no dynamic expressions compiles to a single cloned template and no bindings.
- A literal `poster="javascript:alert(1)"` is E1003, and the same value bound dynamically renders as `about:blank`.
- Any `srcdoc`, and a `vbscript:` URL in any URL attribute, is E1003 as a literal and `about:blank` when bound.
- A literal `src="logo.png"` is not E1501; `href="/orders"` is.
- `<img alt="">`, an unnamed `<section>`, `<td>` and `<li>` with text render with no E1702.
- A file with a syntax error yields only E1000, also in `routes.ts` at build time.
- A `routes.ts` throwing a plain Error is E1006; throwing `{ code: 'E1502' }` keeps E1502.
